help: One long continuous shot (~29 s at 24 fps, two sliding windows). Upload ONE Start Image and several End Images: each End Image is the destination of a later window, so the action moves from milestone to milestone. Motion and audio carry over between windows through the overlap (18 frames). If VRAM/RAM is tight, lower the window size to 243 and use a lower resolution. Prompt Enhancer (Write button) mode: 'H3 NSFW First/Last Frame Prompt' (FL2VA).
